fields.acceptance: go build ./... and go vet ./... pass with the packages removed; a testscript runs rhiza tui app roadmap, model, health, changes, show and live and each exits 4 with unknown app; the existing testscripts of the commands those apps wrapped (roadmap, show, why, slice, health, change ls) pass unchanged.
fields.statement: The changes, health, model, read, roadmap, write, live and requests apps are gone: their packages under internal/tui, their branches in cmd/rhiza/tui.go, their tests and testscripts, and internal/tui/modelapp in the Makefile's budget packages; the CLI commands they wrapped stay.

fields.acceptance: A test in internal/api counts exactly five rex.action entries, named rhiza_app_inbox, rhiza_app_request, rhiza_app_runs, rhiza_app_daemon and rhiza_app_autonomy, each with one key; the rex-install testscript, with a fake rex, greps those five and grep -count=5 for rex.action.
fields.statement: rhiza rex install registers exactly five Rex actions with their keys in the rhiza key mode: inbox, request, runs, daemon and autonomy.
